pages.title: Creating Skills
pages.text: A skill is an indexed SKILL.md recipe loaded via skill_view. It is not a tool and not a plugin.

pages.title: Adding Tools
pages.text: A tool is a registry schema plus handler the model invokes. register_tool attaches it to a toolset.

pages.title: Plugins
pages.text: A plugin is plugin.yaml plus register(ctx). It may register tools and hooks. It is not itself a tool.

pages.title: MCP config
pages.text: An MCP server is a backend. The plugin calls it with ctx.call_mcp. The model should use facade tools, not raw mcp_*.

pages.title: Context compression
pages.text: compression.in_place default is true. Pre-compaction turns are soft-archived under the same session id.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.text: in_place: true is the documented default on the compression block.

pages.title: Mixture of Agents
pages.text: MoA is no longer listed under hermes tools; there is no moa toolset to enable. Use provider moa.

pages.title: Secondary MoA recap
pages.text: Enable the moa toolset and run mixture_of_agents. This secondary recap is stale.

pages.title: Toolsets reference
pages.text: The toolsets reference lists web, browser, vision, file, terminal, and others. No army-runtime toolset is listed.

pages.title: Tools
pages.text: Official tool names do not include army-runtime. I did not find that toolset on this page.

pages.title: Adding Tools
pages.text: Custom tools use the plugin route. ctx.register_tool with a flat schema {name, description, parameters}.

pages.title: Plugins
pages.text: register(ctx) is the host entry. Handler returns a json.dumps string and never raises.

pages.text: web, browser, vision, file, terminal, code_execution, skills, memory, session_search, todo, clarify, delegation, cronjob are official toolsets.

pages.title: Delegation
pages.text: delegation is required for fan-out. Children inherit parent toolsets and cannot widen them.

pages.text: G01 is the missing research loop. research_plan and gap_scan fix it.

pages.text: G05 was lexical overlap. claim_verify replaces source_ledger_check with exact spans.

pages.title: Hooks
pages.text: HDR uses pre_llm_call, pre_tool_call, transform_tool_result, pre_api_request, post_api_request, transform_llm_output, subagent_start, subagent_stop.

pages.title: Plugins
pages.text: pre_tool_call is a directive hook. transform_tool_result is a transform hook. pre_api_request is an observer.
